title: Multi-Agent Scheduling with LLM-Assisted Contract Net Negotiation for Stream Processing in Mobile Edge Computing
abstract: arXiv:2608.12371v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Stream-processing systems increasingly operate across heterogeneous mobile edge--cloud infrastructures, where workload volatility, resource contention, and stringent quality-of-service (QoS) requirements complicate decentralized scheduling. This paper proposes \emph{MAS-DecStream}, whose main contribution is \emph{LLM-MR-CNP}: an extension of the classical Contract Net Protocol with semantic CFP formulation, progressive context disclosure, multi-round proposal revision, negotiation memory, and deterministic validation. Edge-cluster agents refine natural-language offloading proposals from local observations, predicted resource states, and qualitative runtime context, while hard resource and QoS constraints remain deterministic. translated_title: 多智能体调度与LLM辅助合同网协商在移动边缘计算流处理中的应用
translated_abstract: 流处理系统日益在异构移动边缘-云基础设施上运行，其中工作负载波动、资源争用和严格的QoS要求使分布式调度复杂化。本文提出MAS-DecStream，其主要贡献是LLM-MR-CNP：经典合同网协议的扩展，包括语义化CFP制定、渐进式上下文披露、多轮提案修订、协商记忆和确定性验证。边缘集群代理根据局部观察、预测资源状态和定性运行时上下文细化自然语言卸载提案，同时硬性资源和QoS约束保持确定性。基于阿里巴巴ASI轨迹的实验在三个层面评估了该扩展：单轮与多轮CNP、基于规则与LLM辅助细化、固定模型单轮与多轮协商。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于LLM增强的合同网协议扩展（LLM-MR-CNP），通过语义化提案生成和多轮协商机制，在移动边缘计算中实现更高效的流处理任务调度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM-enhanced Contract Net Protocol extension (LLM-MR-CNP) with semantic proposal generation and multi-round negotiation for more efficient stream processing task scheduling in mobile edge computing.
